We first need to decompose the integrand into its quotient and remainder parts, which we can do using synthetic division.

We draw up a synthetic division table:

$$
\begin{aligned} & {x}^{3} & {x}^{2} & {x}^{1} & {x}^{0} \\ 1 & 2 & -3 & 2 & -1 \\  & ↓ & 2 & -1 & 1 \\  & 2 & -1 & 1 & 0\end{aligned}
$$

So from the synthetic division, we get that

$$
\frac{2{x}^{3}-3{x}^{2}+2x-1}{x-1}=2{x}^{2}-x+1.
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{1}\frac{2{x}^{3}-3{x}^{2}+2x-1}{x-1}\,\text{d}x & ={\int }_{0}^{1}(2{x}^{2}-x+1)\text{d}x \\  & =2{\int }_{0}^{1}{x}^{2}\,\text{d}x-{\int }_{0}^{1}x\,\text{d}x+{\int }_{0}^{1}\text{d}x \\  & =2\frac{{x}^{3}}{3}{|}_{0}^{1}-\frac{{x}^{2}}{2}{|}_{0}^{1}+x{|}_{0}^{1} \\  & =2[\frac{{1}^{3}}{3}-\frac{{0}^{3}}{3}]-[\frac{{1}^{2}}{2}-\frac{{0}^{2}}{2}]+[1-0] \\  & =\frac{2}{3}-\frac{1}{2}+1 \\  & =\frac{7}{6}.\end{aligned}
$$
